messages:
andrea: Heads-up: found a broken link in runtime/runbooks/auto-scaler.md -> step 3 points to internal /deploy/api-v2 which 404s. Can someone own a quick fix? link: https://kb.redwood.dev/runtime/runbooks/auto-scaler#step-3

sam: I saw that too earlier — looks like the `/deploy` API got renamed. I can take this if nobody else is on it. quick change to the anchor should do it.

mike: if someone fixes the anchor, please also check the top image (staging showed a 403 for that CDN asset). pinging @doc-bot to run a link/image check.

doc-bot: link-checker report: 1 broken internal link, 1 image 403. Created ticket KBD-411 for the broken link and KBD-412 for the image asset.

leila: Quick patch approach: `git grep -l "/deploy/api-v2" docs | xargs sed -i 's#/deploy/api-v2#/deploy/api-v2-stable#g'` — I'll open a PR against docs/runtime and run the link-checker in CI. assigning review to @sam?

sam: :thumbsup: sounds good. if it's just anchor changes, quick review is fine. @mike can you confirm whether the image 403 is a staging-only token expiry or a production issue?

mike: digging in — staging CDN token for `kb-staging-assets` expired; not production. I raised INF-223 with infra to refresh tokens and reupload the asset. will post back here once it's live.

andrea: thanks. @leila please add a one-line changelog entry noting the redirect/alias so history is retained. what's ETA for the PR?

leila: ETA ~30m. will post PR link here when ready.

mike: infra ticket INF-223 opened; ETA ~2 hours for token rollover and reupload. tagging for follow-up in this thread.

leila: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1298 — updated anchor, added changelog entry. requested review from @sam. Will hold merge until the image is rehosted or CI link-check passes.

sam: reviewed, lgtm. merge after infra confirms image rehost or if CI link-check passes without the staging asset.

andrea: :tada: thanks everyone — marking owner for the patch: leila; reviewer: sam. leaving this thread open until INF-223 is resolved.
